title: back from the hospital - (your sign to take care of yourself)
en: hello everyone i hope you're having a nice week and you are taking care of yourself i just wanted to stop in and give a very short little note saying a huge thank you for the really kind response in my last video unfortunately i do not have a video this week because i um i started feeling very poorly several days ago and i just couldn't do my normal daily activities and i didn't know what was going on thankfully i was able to get to a hospital about an hour so away and they were able to help me and i'm on some antibiotics i am already starting to feel better and i will no doubt be back to my normal routine by

next week but i did realize i definitely had to take some time to recover a bit as i was quite tired and nauseous from the antibiotics that all being said i have had a little bit of time off from work and i have been doing a little bit of painting i have been reading a book shady hollow i was really enjoying it it's a sort of um murder mystery but at the same time it's set in this really adorable cozy little woodland grove full of sweet little animals so it's quite funny to read and i've definitely enjoyed something very simple and escapist during this time that i've been in bed quite a bit also

been lighting a lot of candles because i always like candles especially when i'm not feeling super well and i'm reading a lot of books so no doubt i will be back to normal by next week i need to be on these medications for a couple weeks but i am hopeful that by next week already be a lot better i really do wish i could make a video this week but i'm just not quite there so working with my camera takes quite a bit of time and energy so i definitely wanted to respect my um my body and my need to take it a little bit easier this week please take care of yourselves eat good food drink a lot of water sleep well you know you're

your health is very important you know whatever is healthy to you internal external health mental health spiritual health all of that is quite important so i will see you all next week and i'm sending you all my love goodbye
zh: 大家好，我希望你们度过了愉快的一周，你们照顾好自己，我只是想停下来写一个简短的小纸条，说声非常感谢你们在我上一个视频中的真诚回复，不幸的是我这周没有视频，因为我几天前开始感觉很糟糕，我无法进行正常的日常活动，我不知道发生了什么事，谢天谢地，我能够在大约一个小时的路程之外到达医院，他们能够帮助我，我正在接受一些治疗。抗生素 我已经开始感觉好些了，毫无疑问我会恢复正常生活
下周，但我确实意识到我肯定需要一些时间来恢复，因为我因抗生素而感到非常疲倦和恶心，所有人都说我已经休息了一点时间，我一直在画一点画，我一直在读一本书《阴凉的空心》，我真的很喜欢它，这是一种嗯谋杀之谜，但同时它发生在这个非常可爱舒适的小树林里，里面充满了可爱的小动物，所以读起来很有趣，我已经在这段时间我也躺在床上，我绝对喜欢一些非常简单和逃避现实的东西
点了很多蜡烛，因为我总是喜欢蜡烛，尤其是当我感觉不太舒服并且读了很多书的时候，所以毫无疑问我会在下周恢复正常，我需要服用这些药物几周，但我希望到下周已经好多了，我真的希望我这周能制作一个视频，但我只是不太在那里，所以使用我的相机需要相当多的时间和精力，所以我绝对想尊重我的身体和我需要接受它这周稍微轻松一点，请照顾好自己，吃好东西，喝很多水，睡个好觉，你知道你在
你的健康非常重要你知道什么对你来说是健康的内部外部健康心理健康精神健康所有这些都非常重要所以我下周再见，我向你们致以我所有的爱再见
